description: 100 manually authored navigation/page-visibility checks grounded in source views. These are test definitions, not recorded pass results.

checks.title: Open Login and check the email field
checks.action: Open the Login link in a signed-out browser.
checks.expected: The Email field is visible, labelled and accepts focus; the page is not blank.

checks.title: Open Login and check the password/passcode field
checks.action: Open Login and move from Email to the password/passcode field.
checks.expected: The password/passcode input is visible, masks entered text and has a working visibility toggle.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check Today's Appointments table
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled Today's Appointments table.
checks.expected: Time, Name, Type, Status and Provider columns are visible; records or the intended empty state are shown.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check office and provider filters
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled office and provider filters.
checks.expected: All Offices and Any Provider controls are visible when the account configuration enables them.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check appointment calendar
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled appointment calendar.
checks.expected: The configured appointment calendar widget is visible and finishes loading.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check appointment charges section
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled appointment charges section.
checks.expected: The appointment charges table and its headers are visible for the enabled widget.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check reviews section
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled reviews section.
checks.expected: The review table and rating/office/provider filters are visible when reviews are enabled.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check Provider Call List
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled Provider Call List.
checks.expected: The enabled Provider Call List renders its table or intended empty state.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check Tasks section
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled Tasks section.
checks.expected: The Tasks table is visible and each synthetic task link opens the corresponding patient task page.

checks.title: Go to Dashboard and check Referrals section
checks.action: Click Dashboard in the sidebar and locate the enabled Referrals section.
checks.expected: The Referrals table is visible and an existing synthetic referral link opens its submission details.

checks.title: Open Charts and check MRN search
checks.action: Click Charts and inspect the search area.
checks.expected: The MRN field, search action and patient result area are visible.

checks.title: Open Charts and follow a patient result
checks.action: Search for the seeded synthetic patient and click its result link.
checks.expected: The correct patient dashboard opens; patient identity and the patient navigation are visible.

checks.title: Open Patient Dashboard and check Allergies
checks.action: Open the synthetic patient from Charts and inspect Allergies.
checks.expected: Allergies and Allergy Additional Notes render for the selected synthetic patient.

checks.title: Open Patient Dashboard and check Medications
checks.action: Open the synthetic patient from Charts and inspect Medications.
checks.expected: Medications and Medications Additional Notes render without switching patient context.

checks.title: Open Patient Dashboard and check Health History
checks.action: Open the synthetic patient from Charts and inspect Health History.
checks.expected: Health History and its notes section are visible or show the designed empty/suppressed state.

checks.title: Open Patient Dashboard and check Recent Invoices
checks.action: Open the synthetic patient from Charts and inspect Recent Invoices.
checks.expected: Recent Invoices is visible; opening an existing synthetic invoice reaches that invoice detail page.

checks.title: Open Demographics and check Patient Info tab
checks.action: Click Demographics in the selected patient navigation.
checks.expected: The Patient Info tab is active and patient information fields are visible.

checks.title: Open Demographics and switch to Emergency Contact
checks.action: Open Demographics and select the Emergency Contact tab.
checks.expected: The Emergency Contact panel opens, and switching back to Patient Info works without losing patient context.

checks.title: Open Insurance and check Add Policy entry
checks.action: Click Insurance and then Add Policy; close the form without saving.
checks.expected: The policy form opens with Plan Type and Insurance Company fields and can be closed safely.

checks.title: Open Insurance and check policy form sections
checks.action: Open Add Policy for the synthetic patient without submitting.
checks.expected: Plan Type, Medical Insurance Type, insured-party and plan fields are visible with readable labels.

checks.title: Open Eligibility Lookup and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Eligibility from the synthetic patient navigation.
checks.expected: Eligibility Lookup, payer selection and provider selection render; do not submit a paid lookup.

checks.title: Open patient SMS inbox and check its main sections
checks.action: Open the patient SMS Inbox tab.
checks.expected: The Messages thread area is visible; the composer or a clear availability notice is displayed.

checks.title: Open patient Forms and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Forms for the synthetic patient.
checks.expected: The Forms table, Send A Form entry and completed-form area render without sending a form.

checks.title: Open Treatment Plans and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Treatment Plans and click Add Treatment Plan; cancel.
checks.expected: The treatment-plan form opens with Template, Provider, Title and date fields, then closes without saving.

checks.title: Open Clinical Notes and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Clinical Notes and its Add Clinical Note entry; cancel.
checks.expected: The notes list and add-note form render; cancelling returns to the list.

checks.title: Open Material Log and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Material Log and its Add Material entry; close it.
checks.expected: The material log page and Add Material control render without creating a material entry.

checks.title: Open patient Tasks and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Tasks and click Add Task; cancel.
checks.expected: The task form shows Title, Description, Due Date and assignment controls; Cancel closes it.

checks.title: Open patient Ledger and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Ledger from the synthetic patient menu.
checks.expected: Aging balances and Add Charges, Add Payments, Add Adjustments and Issue Refund entries are visible when permitted; do not post a transaction.

checks.title: Open patient Images and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Images and click Upload Images; close without uploading.
checks.expected: The image list and upload panel render with file controls, and closing returns to the list.

checks.title: Open patient Claims and check its main sections
checks.action: Open Claims for a synthetic patient with a seeded claim and open its attachment section.
checks.expected: Claim Details and attachment/document sections are visible; no claim is submitted.

checks.title: Open Schedule View and check patient search
checks.action: Open Schedule View from the Appointments menu.
checks.expected: Search Patients is visible and accepts focus.

checks.title: Open Schedule View and check view controls
checks.action: Open Schedule View and inspect View Type and Calendar View Duration.
checks.expected: View controls are visible; switching a permitted view renders the schedule without a broken page.

checks.title: Open Schedule View and check calendar view
checks.action: Open Schedule View and select its calendar presentation.
checks.expected: The calendar area renders and the selected view is reflected in the control.

checks.title: Open Schedule View and check daily availability link
checks.action: Click Edit Daily Availability for a permitted provider; return without saving.
checks.expected: The availability UI opens and can be closed/backed out of without creating an appointment.

checks.title: Open Waitlist and check office/provider filters
checks.action: Click Waitlist from Appointments.
checks.expected: Office and provider filters are visible and populated according to the test account permissions.

checks.title: Open Waitlist and follow a patient link
checks.action: Open Waitlist, then click an existing synthetic patient entry.
checks.expected: Patient, Office, Providers and appointment columns render; the link opens the matching patient/schedule context.

checks.title: Open Upcoming Appointments and check timeframe
checks.action: Click Upcoming Appointments and inspect Show upcoming appointments.
checks.expected: The timeframe selector and office/provider filters render without an endless loading overlay.

checks.title: Open Upcoming Appointments and check table sections
checks.action: Open Upcoming Appointments and inspect an existing synthetic row.
checks.expected: Appointment Date, Patient, Office, Provider, Registration, Insurance and Confirmation columns render; a patient link opens the correct record.

checks.title: Open Appointment Requests and check list
checks.action: Click Appointment Requests in the sidebar.
checks.expected: Submitted, Status, Patient and Requested Office columns render with data or an intended empty state.

checks.title: Open an Appointment Request detail link
checks.action: Click a seeded synthetic request detail link; return to the request list without linking a patient.
checks.expected: The request detail page opens for the chosen request and returning to the list works; no request is changed.

checks.title: Check Paid Invoices table
checks.action: Open Invoices from the sidebar.
checks.expected: Paid invoice columns including Patient, XID, Amount Invoiced and Amount Paid render.

checks.title: Check historical invoice search
checks.action: Click Search Historical Invoices; close the search UI without changing records.
checks.expected: The historical-search controls open and the invoice list remains reachable.

checks.title: Check Create Invoice page
checks.action: From a synthetic patient billing page click Create Invoice; do not submit.
checks.expected: The Create Invoice form opens with patient contact, office and appointment fields.

checks.title: Check invoice amount and due-date controls
checks.action: Open Create Invoice for the synthetic patient and inspect Amount and Due Date.
checks.expected: Amount, Due Date, Description and invoice-type controls are visible and labelled; Cancel/Back returns without creating an invoice.

checks.title: Check Outstanding Invoices table
checks.action: Click Outstanding Invoices in the invoice navigation.
checks.expected: Office, Patient, Amount, Date Created, Aging and last-contact columns render.

checks.title: Check Outstanding Invoices menu
checks.action: Open the Outstanding Invoices Menu for a seeded record, then dismiss it without selecting a write action.
checks.expected: Available menu actions are visible and dismiss cleanly; no reminder is sent and no invoice is changed.

checks.title: Check Adjusted Invoices page
checks.action: Click Adjusted Invoices.
checks.expected: Patient, Current Amount, Previous Amount, Date Adjusted, Adjusted By and Notes columns render.

checks.title: Check Deleted Invoices page
checks.action: Click Deleted Invoices.
checks.expected: Patient, Amount, Date Created, Date Deleted and Deleted By columns render; no restore/delete action is executed.

checks.title: Check Invoice Details page
checks.action: Click the amount link for an existing synthetic invoice in the invoice list.
checks.expected: The chosen invoice detail loads with its amount, contact and office information; refresh preserves the same invoice context.

checks.title: Check Invoice Details office-edit entry
checks.action: Open invoice details, click Update office and cancel.
checks.expected: The office-edit controls open, Save and Cancel are visible, and Cancel leaves the invoice unchanged.

checks.title: Check All Transactions list
checks.action: Open All Transactions from the sidebar.
checks.expected: Office, Date, Patient, Amount, XID, Status and payment-type columns render.

checks.title: Check historical transaction search
checks.action: Open Search Historical Transactions and dismiss it.
checks.expected: The search UI opens and returns to the transaction list without changing a transaction.

checks.title: Check Quick Transaction form
checks.action: Open Quick Transaction from synthetic patient Billing; do not submit payment.
checks.expected: Office, Provider, contact, Amount and payment-method sections render.

checks.title: Check Quick Transaction payment source
checks.action: Inspect Billing Payment Source and saved/new-card choices on Quick Transaction.
checks.expected: Permitted payment-source options render; choosing a display option reveals the matching fields without charging a card.

checks.title: Check Recurring Transactions list
checks.action: Open Recurring Transactions.
checks.expected: Office, Patient, Transaction Amount, Active, Start Date, Next Run Date and Frequency columns render.

checks.title: Check recurring transaction historical search
checks.action: Open Search Historical Recurring Transactions and close it.
checks.expected: Historical search controls render and the recurring transaction list remains reachable.

checks.title: Check Failed Transactions list
checks.action: Open Failed Transactions.
checks.expected: Office, Date, Parent XID, Status, Patient, Amount and Error Message columns render.

checks.title: Check failed transaction historical search
checks.action: Open Search Historical Failed Transactions and dismiss it.
checks.expected: The historical-search UI renders and closes without resubmitting a payment.

checks.title: Check Transaction Details page
checks.action: Follow an existing synthetic transaction detail link from All Transactions.
checks.expected: XID, Office, Transaction Amount, Card Type, last four digits and transaction dates render for the selected record.

checks.title: Check Transaction Details action links
checks.action: Open a suitable seeded successful transaction and inspect its available actions.
checks.expected: Permitted Refund, Void or Recurring entries are visible for that record status; do not execute a financial action.

checks.title: Check Forms list
checks.action: Open Forms from configuration navigation.
checks.expected: Active, Company, Forms, Document Type, Date Created and Date Modified columns render.

checks.title: Check Add Form link
checks.action: Click Add Form, inspect the destination and return without saving.
checks.expected: The form-builder page opens and returning to the Forms list works without creating a document.

checks.title: Check Completed Forms table
checks.action: Open Completed Forms.
checks.expected: Form, Patient, Appointment Date, Provider and Date Completed columns render.

checks.title: Check Completed Forms filters
checks.action: Inspect provider/location filtering and Search Countersign Forms.
checks.expected: The permitted filters and countersign search entry are visible; no form is countersigned.

checks.title: Check Referral Practices list
checks.action: Open referral practices from the sidebar.
checks.expected: Practice, Offices, Referrals, Date Added, Active and Action columns render.

checks.title: Check Add Practice form link
checks.action: Click Add Practice, inspect its form and close it.
checks.expected: Practice name, office/address and contact fields render; closing creates no practice.

checks.title: Check Referral tabs
checks.action: Open Patient Referrals and switch among Active Referrals, Contacted & Scheduled and Archived Referrals.
checks.expected: Each tab shows its own list/filter area without losing the referral page.

checks.title: Check Referral submission link
checks.action: Follow an existing synthetic referral submission link, then return.
checks.expected: The chosen submission detail opens and the referral list can be reached again without archiving/linking the record.

checks.title: Check patient message composer
checks.action: Open the message page through an existing synthetic patient conversation link.
checks.expected: Patient context, message history, composer, character counter and Send control render; no message is sent.

checks.title: Check message Back to Previous Page link
checks.action: Enter a synthetic conversation from its originating page, then click Back to Previous Page.
checks.expected: The previous patient/list page opens with the correct context instead of a blank page or broken URL.

checks.title: Check Practice Settings tabs
checks.action: Open Practice Settings and inspect its General, Insurance, EMR, Login Security and Communication tabs.
checks.expected: Configured tabs are visible and changing tabs reveals the corresponding settings panel without saving.

checks.title: Check Practice NPI and Tax ID section
checks.action: Open Practice Settings and inspect the practice-identification section.
checks.expected: Practice NPI and Practice Tax ID controls are visible with the current test-company context.

checks.title: Check Fee Schedule list
checks.action: Open Fee Schedules from Practice Setup.
checks.expected: Name, Status, Year, Date Active and action columns render.

checks.title: Check Create Fee Schedule dialog
checks.action: Click Create Fee Schedule and then Cancel.
checks.expected: Name, Year, Date Begin and Date End fields render; cancelling creates no fee schedule.

checks.title: Check Departments list
checks.action: Open Departments from Practice Setup.
checks.expected: Active, Departments and Date Created columns render with the Add Department entry.

checks.title: Check Add Department dialog
checks.action: Click Add Department, inspect Department Name, then Cancel.
checks.expected: The dialog opens and closes cleanly without adding a department.

checks.title: Check Users list
checks.action: As a permitted admin, open Users.
checks.expected: User Name, Email, Mobile, 2FA, Account Status and Date Last Login columns render.

checks.title: Check Add New User link
checks.action: Click Add New User, inspect the destination and return without submitting.
checks.expected: The new-user editor opens with identity/security/account fields; returning to Users creates no account.

checks.title: Check User Settings general panel
checks.action: Open the signed-in user account settings.
checks.expected: First Name, Last Name, Email, Mobile Phone and Two Factor Authentication controls render.

checks.title: Check User Settings preference tabs
checks.action: Switch to Provider Preferences and Custom View, then return to General without saving.
checks.expected: Each settings tab opens its matching panel and the General tab remains reachable.

checks.title: Open Production/Collection report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: View By, Office, Provider and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Adjustments report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: View By, Office, Provider and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Accounts Receivable report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Aging buckets 0-30 through 121+, Total, View By, Office and Provider controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Payments report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: The report date-range controls and Run Report entry render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Materials Search report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Category, Materials, Lot, Serial Number and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Materials Usage report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Category, Materials, Provider and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Appointment Charges report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Procedure Code, date-range and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Patients Registered report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Date-range selection and Run Report are visible; the results section becomes reachable after a permitted read-only report run. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Account Status report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Account Status selection and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Open Claim Summary by Carrier report and check its filters
checks.action: Open this report from the Reports navigation using an account permitted to view it.
checks.expected: Payer, Claim Category, Type and Run Report controls render. The report opens at the correct route, not a 404 or server error.

checks.title: Check Your Bills list
checks.action: Open Customer Billing > Bills.
checks.expected: Your bills, Status, Year, Month, Usage, Amount Due and Billed on sections render; use the intended empty state if no bills exist.

checks.title: Check Bills filters and detail link
checks.action: Inspect Status/Year filters; if a seeded bill exists, click View and return.
checks.expected: Filters render and an existing bill opens its matching detail page without paying the bill.

checks.title: Check Your Payments summary
checks.action: Open Customer Billing > Payments.
checks.expected: Summary of balances and the outstanding-balance area are visible.

checks.title: Check Your Payments list
checks.action: Inspect the payments list and Bill period/Status filters.
checks.expected: The payment table/cards show Date, Status, Card and Amount with working display filters.

checks.title: Check Payment Methods list
checks.action: Open Customer Billing > Payment Methods.
checks.expected: Cards On File and Default, Type, Last Four, Expiration and Added columns render.

checks.title: Check Add Payment Method link
checks.action: Click Add Payment Method and inspect the page; return without submitting.
checks.expected: Contact, billing address and card-entry controls render; no card is saved or charged.

checks.title: Check Notifications list
checks.action: Open Notifications.
checks.expected: Date Created, Name, Description, Start, End and Recurring columns render with permitted controls.

checks.title: Check Add Notification form
checks.action: Click Add Notification, inspect the form and Cancel.
checks.expected: Name, Description, Content and start/end controls render; cancelling publishes no notification.

checks.title: Check Insurance Types configuration
checks.action: Open Insurance Types in Practice Setup.
checks.expected: Insurance Health Types and Insurance Types sections render with their active/name settings.

checks.title: Check Help Center search and categories
checks.action: Open Help Center, enter a documented help-topic keyword and select a category/topic.
checks.expected: The search field, CATEGORIES and TOPICS areas render; selecting a listed topic opens its content without a broken link.
